messages:
ana: Quick heads-up — Sales asked for a one-pager we can use to lock committed dedicated pools w/ conditional burst credits. Wanted to surface tradeoffs before docs.

David: +1. what's the ask exactly?

ana: Customer wants predictable baseline for latency + the ability to spike above baseline using a 'commitment delta' buffer that decays daily. They also want a CSV export for billing.

kevin: Sales POV — priority is 'no unexpected throttles' for X-tier customers. They like a feature where burst credits are 'borrowable' from next period in emergencies (customer-facing language: "emergency buffer").

rachel: ops: Preemption rules need to be explicit. Borrowable credits complicate fairness unless we add a hard per-tenant upper cap. Suggest policy: borrow <= 20% of next period commitment and auto-repay rate 10%/day.

jon: eng: Implementation sketch — add "commitment_delta" and "borrowed_amount" fields on tenant config + runtime enforcement in admission controller. Pseudo enforcement:
```
if tenant.borrowed_amount > tenant.delta_cap:
  reject_request()
if tenant.borrowed_amount > 0:
  priority_score -= borrowed_penalty
```

ana: CSV export columns the customer requested: tenant_id, committed_tokens, used_baseline, borrowed_amount, delta_cap, repayment_rate, sla_tier

kevin: can we include a sample line for sales decks? would be helpful.

david: quick sample (one-liner we can drop into docs):
```
tenant_123,1000000,200000,50000,200000,10%/day,enterprise
```

rachel: Observability ask — alert when borrowed_amount > 50% of delta_cap and when repayment falls behind 48 hours. Add an ops dashboard card for per-tenant repayment velocity.

jon: rough eng estimate: 2 engineers, 3 sprints (includes admission controller change, billing CSV endpoint, e2e telemetry, and a rollout runbook).

ana: Product decision proposal: tiered borrow caps (enterprise:30%, standard:10%, trial:0%), default repayment_rate 10%/day with opt-in faster repayment, and a hard emergency hard-cap at 50% of committed tokens. Schedule: prototype + sales demo in 6 weeks. Any blockers?

kevin: no blockers from sales. Will prepare 2 customer examples (low-LTV and high-LTV) for Wed sync.

rachel: ops asks for an ops-only dry-run in staging that simulates borrow and repayment churn before any GA.

ana: agreed — I'll set up Tue 30m sync (eng + ops + kevin). Agenda: finalize percentages, telemetry events, CSV schema, and rollout gating.

deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap review on 2024-11-05 10:00 UTC (add as agenda item: "Commitment Delta proposal")
